messages:
priya: PR #8732 is blocked on architecture review — added a canary but we need an RFC link and arch sign-off before merge. @santiago @anna can you take a look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/8732. Short summary: shard-affinity change may affect runtime routing and KV cache invalidation.
santiago: Saw it, thanks. Can you paste the RFC link? I couldn't find it in the PR description.
priya: RFC is here: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/56-shard-affinity-and-kv-consistency.md. Also note perf impact estimate in the PR: ~3-5% tail latency at 1k seq.
anna: Thanks — I'll read through today. Quick question: does this require a shard-migration job? If so add a migration checklist to the PR.
priya: No migration job needed, it's a routing policy change only. But we do need a canary rollout that falls back to old routing on mismatch. Example snippet from RFC to include in PR:
```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 10%
  fallback: previous-routing
```
I'll add that to the PR description and the deployment playbook.
deploy-bot: CI passed for commit 9a3f2b — integration tests 124/124 green :white_check_mark:.
santiago: Ok arch-team ping — @arch-team can we get eyes and a quick thumbs for safety? Would like to merge tomorrow morning if no blockers.
anna: :thumbsup: leaving a couple comments, will LGTM after you add the migration checklist and a unit test for affinity mismatch. @priya can you add that test?
priya: On it — will push a small unit test and the checklist by EOD.
